Subject: Vendor activation: procurement onboarding docs & PO instructions

Hi Jonas —

Thanks for taking this through. We're ready to move forward with Redwood for inference serving and need the procurement/onboarding checklist so our finance team can issue a PO. Can you confirm the items your team needs from us to complete vendor setup? Specifically:

- Executed DPA (if you have a standard template we can sign)
- SOC 2 report (or link to current report)
- Subprocessor list (we need to confirm data residency)
- Invoice remit & PO routing (email and any required vendor codes)
- Any tax forms you require (W-9 / VAT docs)

We're attaching a draft SOW and will prep tax forms once we have the billing details.

[Attachment: ElevateCloud_SOW.pdf]

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call if that's easier.

— Maya

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Apr 2025 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor activation: procurement onboarding docs & PO instructions

Hi Maya — thanks for the clear list and the SOW. Welcome aboard! High level next steps from our side so your finance team can proceed: 

1) DPA: I attached our standard DPA template — if you need redlines please send them to legal@redwood.com and we'll triage. If you want a quick turnaround, copy me and Rishi.
2) SOC 2: see link below (public report + encrypted artifact); procurement typically reviews the public report and requests the encrypted artifact via secure link.
3) Subprocessors: we've attached a current export of our subprocessor registry. If you have specific residency constraints let us know and we'll run the compatibility check.
4) PO / invoices: please route the PO to procurement@redwood.com and reference vendor code RW-VC-472 in the PO. Invoices should be sent to invoices@redwood.com. Our AP contact is noted in the checklist.
5) Tax forms: if you're US-based send W-9; international vendors can send equivalent VAT forms.

I've attached a short onboarding checklist with the above items to make it easy for your team. Priyom (procurement) will follow up with PO routing and any required procurement fields. Rishi (account lead) will handle commercial questions.

[Attachment: redwood_onboarding_checklist.pdf]
[Attachment: redwood_dpa_template.pdf]

Happy to jump on a 15 min call today if helpful.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.com

Date: Thu, 17 Apr 2025 10:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor activation: procurement onboarding docs & PO instructions

Hi Maya — copying procurement and legal next steps so everything is in one thread. Per our checklist, please see the items and links below: 

- SOC 2 Type II (current): https://redwood-inference.s3.amazonaws.com/soc2-report-2024.pdf (password-protected artifact available upon request).
- DPA: Our standard DPA is attached (Jonas included it), we're happy to execute via DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/participants/ELEV-2025-007
- Subprocessors: Current list attached and also available here: https://drive.google.com/redwood/onboarding/ELEV-2025-007 (column "Data Location" indicates region). If you require that no subprocessors process EU data outside the EU, flag that and we'll escalate for an SSO/data routing plan.

PO details:
- Please route PO to: procurement@redwood.com
- Vendor code (for AP): RW-VC-472
- Invoice remit: invoices@redwood.com
- Payment terms: Net 30 (default) — if you need Net 45 please indicate and include the finance approver.

Procurement asks from Elevate Cloud to complete vendor setup:
- Completed vendor profile (attached PO template)
- W-9 (or VAT registration docs)
- Signed SOW or SOW reference in the PO

Action owner assignments:
- Elevate: upload vendor profile + tax docs + issue PO (Maya).
- Redwood procurement (Priyom): confirm PO fields and return vendor code confirmation.
- Redwood legal (cc Rishi): DPA/DocuSign execution.

[Attachment: redwood_po_template.xlsx]
[Attachment: redwood_subprocessor_registry.csv]

Thanks — Priyom, can you confirm once RW-VC-472 is active so Maya's AP team can include it on the PO?

Regards,
Grace O'Connor
Head of Procurement, Redwood Inference
grace@redwood.com

Thanks Grace — very helpful. A couple quick items: 

- We'll upload the vendor profile and W-9 today and target to issue the PO by EOD tomorrow.
- Quick question on the subprocessor registry: Am I reading correctly that the Redis caching provider (listed as CacheGrid Ltd.) processes token metadata in the US by default? We need to know if token-level telemetry could land in non-EU regions before we finalize compliance with our data residency policy.

I'll also review the DPA and route the DocuSign link internally. If we need to redline, we'll send those back to legal@redwood.com and copy Rishi.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — we'll report back once the PO is issued.

Best,
Maya
Head of Ops, Elevate Cloud Inc.
